request.question:
The production database connectors are the classes that directly subclass SQLDatabase (defined in auto_ontology/connectors/base.py), excluding any class defined in test code (every file under a tests/ folder counts as test code). For each such connector class, which public methods does the class define in its own body that SQLDatabase itself does not define? A method is public when its name does not start with an underscore (so __init__ and other dunder methods are excluded); anything written with def directly in the class body counts as a method, including properties and context-manager methods. Methods inherited without being redefined do not count. Return one row per (connector class symbol ID, method name).

Requested output columns: class_symbol_id (string), method_name (string).
Return exactly the requested output columns, using each requested name as the column alias, in the requested order. Return complete repository-relative file paths and complete symbol IDs exactly as stored. When the question asks which files, symbols or modules, return each distinct one once unless it asks for occurrences.

events.sql: WITH sql_database AS (SELECT symbol_id FROM auto_ontology_code.code.symbol_profile WHERE file_id = 'auto_ontology/connectors/base.py' AND name = 'SQLDatabase' AND is_class = TRUE), sql_database_methods AS (SELECT name FROM auto_ontology_code.code.symbol_profile WHERE enclosing_class_symbol_id IN (SELECT symbol_id FROM sql_database) AND is_method = TRUE) SELECT DISTINCT cb.class_symbol_id AS class_symbol_id, m.name AS method_name FROM auto_ontology_code.code.class_bases AS cb JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.symbol_profile AS cls ON cls.symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.symbol_profile AS m ON m.enclosing_class_symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id WHERE cb.base_symbol_id IN (SELECT symbol_id FROM sql_database) AND cls.is_class = TRUE AND cls.in_test_file = FALSE AND m.is_method = TRUE AND m.is_public = TRUE AND m.in_test_file = FALSE AND substr(m.name, 1, 1) <> '_' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sql_database_methods AS sm WHERE sm.name = m.name) ORDER BY cb.class_symbol_id, m.name

gold_sql: SELECT b.class_symbol_id, m.name AS method_name FROM code.class_bases b JOIN code.symbols c ON c.symbol_id = b.class_symbol_id JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = c.file_id JOIN code.symbols m ON m.file_id = c.file_id AND m.kind = 'method' AND m.qualname = c.qualname || '.' || m.name WHERE b.base_symbol_id = 'auto_ontology/connectors/base.py::SQLDatabase' AND NOT f.is_test AND m.is_public AND m.name NOT IN (SELECT bm.name FROM code.symbols bm WHERE bm.file_id = 'auto_ontology/connectors/base.py' AND bm.kind = 'method' AND bm.qualname LIKE 'SQLDatabase.%') ORDER BY 1, 2
